import sys, yaml
from deepdiff import DeepDiff

a = yaml.safe_load(open("{{file_a}}"))
b = yaml.safe_load(open("{{file_b}}"))

diff = DeepDiff(a, b, ignore_order=True, view='tree')
if not diff:
    print("identical"); sys.exit(0)

for change_type, items in diff.items():
    print(f"\n=== {change_type} ===")
    for item in items:
        print(f"  path: {item.path()}")
        print(f"  before: {item.t1!r}")
        print(f"  after:  {item.t2!r}")
sys.exit(1)
summary_zh: YAML 語意 diff 忽略順序顯示樹狀差異
